summary: 3717 sharpens the F_1/B_QK target: point extremum is insufficient, but a parent-owned zero-section family F_z(q)=0 implies B_QK=partial_q F_z=0. The Fisher/KL fibre core from 3708 gives F_1=0, B_QK=0, and M_K=Theta_H I_H conditionally, while odd corrections and boundary mixed terms are retained as explicit nonclaim rows.
